goal: Given a recipient snapshot, return reproducible ranked donor pre-screen candidates, and given a donor snapshot, return reproducible ranked recipient candidates, both with transparent gates, per-locus mismatches with explicit UNKNOWN and partial-typing ranges, and the policy and reference versions used.
non_goals: matchability or waiting-time terms in the ranking
molecular mismatch scores from low-resolution typing
preconditions: matching policy version IR_KIDNEY_SCREEN_2.0 adopted after HA-004
invariants: same input snapshot+policy gives same output
the mismatch count is host-versus-graft and is computed with the recipient in the recipient argument in both directions
a blocking bucket is never displayed as a low rank
losing information never improves a candidate's position
a role-UNKNOWN profile appears in neither direction
one allele read is never treated as homozygous
acceptance: positive physical crossmatch hard-stops direct pathway
amount changes do not change ordering
rank explanation exactly reconstructs sort keys
ranking donors for a recipient and ranking recipients for a donor both run and agree on the mismatch vector for the same ordered pair
a donor with two HLA-B mismatches and zero DRB1 mismatch outranks a donor with zero HLA-B and one DRB1 mismatch
a partially typed locus yields a range and never a bare zero
deleting any locus typing from a candidate never improves its rank, including DRB3/4/5
